captions.detailed: This 3D model features a bicycle handlebar and dropper seatpost assembly. It includes a curved black handlebar with textured grips and a small remote lever mounted on the left side. The seatpost consists of a dark-anesthetized outer tube and a metallic silver inner tube that telescopically slides inside it, capped with a black saddle mounting bracket. The wireless remote lever pivots on a hinge to simulate actuation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a bicycle dropper seatpost and handlebar assembly. The seatpost should feature a prismatic joint allowing the silver inner tube to slide inside the dark outer tube, and a handlebar assembly with a revolute joint for the wireless remote lever.
captions.factory: The code constructs several parts using Cylinder and Box primitives. The base frame/handlebar is modeled using swept or rotated cylinders for the bars, grips, and stem. The outer seatpost tube is a dark cylinder, while the inner telescoping tube is a lighter silver cylinder. A prismatic joint is defined to allow vertical motion of the inner tube relative to the outer tube, and a revolute joint is defined for the small remote lever attached to the handlebar.
